name: Ultimate Light Rail
summary: Light rail stations: surface, underground or elevated, with five lengths and covered platforms.
description: Ultimate Light Rail 0.17.0 completes the bundled station family migration to API v1 component kits. Surface and elevated stations now explicitly select the same 20m platform and canopy reference components available to add-ons, with the existing greenery, furniture and entrance bench preserved. Surface stations remain uncovered by default; elevated stations remain covered. The underground station also uses the API, retaining its fixed native hall as defined in v1. Track layouts, terminal references, walking routes, costs and saved parameter indices are unchanged across all 72 automated reference cases. All 27 underground/legacy cases retain their complete previous output. Visible model assembly intentionally changes to 20m modules; short infills and fixed stairs remain core-owned. The user confirmed independent example-mod placement, boarding and switch operation in two tested variants; the migrated bundled family still needs an in-game visual check. API documentation and maker templates are included in the repository/developer pack. No automatic rebuilding of saved stations. Do not remove the mod while its infrastructure remains in a save.
